description: Dependency updates for the formulate monorepo (SHO-146). Pins that exist for a documented reason are excluded below, each citing its ADR, so Renovate never proposes breaking them.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: NativeWind is a preview release pinned exactly; previews break between versions. See docs/adr/0003-nativewind-v5-and-tailwind-v4.md.
lightningcss must stay at 1.30.1: newer versions fail at Metro bundle time only. Pinned through pnpm overrides. See docs/adr/0004-pin-lightningcss-to-1-30-1.md.
React is pinned workspace-wide to the exact version the Expo SDK expects; a second copy breaks hooks under the hoisted linker. It moves only with an Expo SDK upgrade.
Every other non-major devDependency update in one weekly PR. Listed before the specific groups so they override it (later rules win).

Expo SDK packages and React Native must match the versions the SDK expects, which Renovate cannot know. Grouped, and held on the Dependency Dashboard for a human to approve; apply with `npx expo install --fix` and check with `npx expo install --check`.
Playwright is pinned exactly because each release expects one browser build; axe travels with it.
Next.js and its ESLint config move together.
Lint tooling, grouped so one PR carries a coordinated bump.
Shopify CLI (theme tooling) is pinned exactly; bump deliberately.
GitHub Actions in one PR. Actions pinned by commit SHA (shopify/lighthouse-ci-action) keep their digest pin.
Major updates wait on the Dependency Dashboard for a human decision.
